purpose: Registry of established public benchmarks used as external evidence for Pari English Core. Native/official, full-distribution prompted, fast prompted, and secondary diagnostic results are never silently conflated.

policy.officialEvaluatorProvenance: When an official evaluator exists, promotion-quality evidence pins the evaluator checkout to a full immutable commit, verifies benchmark/reference bytes, executes official code directly where practical, and archives raw evaluator output plus provenance.
policy.licenseRule: Verify the current dataset/repository license and official evaluation split before downloading or redistributing benchmark data. This registry intentionally does not copy benchmark data into Pari.
policy.researchBasis: See ENGLISH_CORE_RESEARCH_BASIS.md, ENGLISH_CORE_NATIVE_PROTOCOLS.md, and RESEARCH_GROUNDING_POLICY.md for construct validity, adaptation caveats, and claim rules.

anchors.name: SWORDS
anchors.role: high-coverage contextual lexical substitution and candidate acceptability for writing assistance
anchors.nativeProtocol: Use the official SWORDS benchmark/result format and official evaluator. Promotion evidence binds the official compressed dataset bytes, official dataset ID, converted result, and evaluator checkout to one provenance chain.
preferredMetrics: optional GAP/legacy metrics when official assets are present

anchors.name: WiC
anchors.nativeProtocol: Classification accuracy on the published task distribution; model adaptation must be stated explicitly.
anchors.pariProtocol: Full validation-distribution zero-shot prompted classification plus a separate balanced fast screen.

anchors.name: CoInCo / SemEval lexical substitution
anchors.role: complementary contextual lexical substitution and ranking
anchors.nativeProtocol: Use the benchmark-native lexical-substitution evaluator/metrics when a reproducible package is established.

anchors.name: Lexical collocation retrieval/categorization benchmark
anchors.nativeProtocol: Reproduce the paper's retrieval/categorization tasks and metrics if the official data/code package can be verified.

anchors.name: BLiMP
anchors.role: minimal-pair grammatical knowledge across 67 linguistic phenomena
anchors.nativeProtocol: Prefer the acceptable sentence when comparing language-model sentence likelihood/probability; report per-phenomenon and aggregate accuracy.
anchors.pariProtocol: Use current MLX-LM + lm-evaluation-harness BLiMP group with chat template disabled for the native likelihood lane; keep Pari prompted BLiMP as a separate screen.
preferredMetrics: prompted-screen accuracy as secondary protocol evidence

anchors.name: CoLA
anchors.nativeProtocol: Report Matthews correlation coefficient on the native task distribution; state model adaptation separately from metric choice.
anchors.pariProtocol: Full validation-distribution zero-shot prompted classification reports MCC; balanced 300-item accuracy remains a fast screen only.

anchors.name: PAWS
anchors.role: high lexical-overlap paraphrase traps including role/order changes
anchors.nativeProtocol: Classification on the published task distribution; preserve the selected split and metric provenance.
anchors.pariProtocol: Full PAWS-Wiki validation-distribution zero-shot prompted classification plus a separate balanced fast screen.
preferredMetrics: F1 where protocol/reporting calls for it

anchors.name: JFLEG
anchors.role: human fluency correction beyond minimal grammar repair
anchors.nativeProtocol: Generate one hypothesis per source sentence and use the official four-reference GLEU evaluation workflow. Promotion evidence pins source, four distinct references, official checkout, evaluator code, hypothesis bytes, and evaluator environment.

anchors.name: GYAFC
anchors.nativeProtocol: Use the established formality-transfer data/protocol with task-appropriate automatic and/or human evaluation; document the exact subset and adaptation.

anchors.name: EditEval relevant editing tasks
anchors.role: primary external anchor for modular text improvement, paraphrasing and cohesion
anchors.nativeProtocol: Use relevant EditEval tasks with their documented task-level evaluation rather than collapsing all editing behaviors into one score.

anchors.name: IteraTeR held-out human revisions
anchors.role: human iterative revision across domains, intentions and granularities
anchors.nativeProtocol: Use held-out human revisions and preserve edit-intention/granularity breakdowns; do not train V1 on the held-out evaluation portion.

anchors.name: WritingBench selected style/language subset
anchors.role: secondary open-ended writing diagnostic only; mixes English competence with planning/domain/instruction-following factors

anchors.name: BeDiscovER focused English subset
anchors.role: discourse relations, sentence ordering, temporal and rhetorical dependencies
anchors.nativeProtocol: Use only the discourse subtasks relevant to prose editing and preserve task-level metrics rather than inventing one Pari discourse score.
